# Documentation Pull Request Template for Zenith DAW

## 📚 Thank You for Improving Our Documentation!

Great documentation is essential for our community. This template helps us maintain high-quality documentation standards.

## Description
Please provide a clear and concise description of what this documentation change accomplishes.

### Type of Documentation Change
Please mark the appropriate type(s):
- [ ] New guide/tutorial
- [ ] Bug fix in existing documentation
- [ ] Clarification of existing content
- [ ] Translation/localization
- [ ] Video tutorial transcript
- [ ] API documentation
- [ ] Troubleshooting guide
- [ ] User manual update
- [ ] Community resources (templates, examples)

## Checklist
Please ensure you have completed the following steps:

### Documentation Quality
- [ ] The documentation follows our [style guide](https://github.com/your-repo/zenith-daw/blob/main/docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The content is accurate and up-to-date
- [ ] Screenshots and diagrams are clear and properly labeled
- [ ] Code examples are properly formatted and tested
- [ ] Links are working and point to the correct resources
- [ ] The language is clear and accessible to all skill levels

### Structure and Organization
- [ ] The content follows our [documentation structure](https://github.com/your-repo/zenith-daw/blob/main/docs/STRUCTURE.md)
- [ ] Headings and subheadings are properly formatted
- [ ] Table of contents is updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Related links and cross-references are included
- [ ] Content is properly categorized and tagged

### Accessibility
- [ ] The content is accessible to people with disabilities
- [ ] Images have alt text descriptions
- [ ] Video content has captions and transcripts
- [ ] Color is not the only means of conveying information
- [ ] Font sizes and contrast are readable

### Testing
- [ ] I have tested all steps in the documentation
- [ ] Code examples work as described
- [ ] Screenshots are current with the software
- [ ] Links to external resources are valid
- [ ] The documentation is complete and not missing steps
